controls.label: Prior alpha
controls.help: Raises the Prior mean and shifts Posterior alpha; a larger α pulls the Posterior mean toward 1.

controls.label: Prior beta
controls.help: Lowers the Prior mean and shifts Posterior beta; a larger β pulls the Posterior mean toward 0.

controls.label: Observed successes
controls.help: Increases Posterior alpha and usually raises the Posterior mean; also changes the posterior parameter pair.

controls.label: Observed failures
controls.help: Increases Posterior beta and usually lowers the Posterior mean; also changes the posterior parameter pair.

explorations.title: Data dominates a weak prior
explorations.instruction: Predict: using alpha=1 and beta=1 (prior mean 0.5), will 8 successes and 2 failures pull the posterior mean above or below 0.75? Then apply the preset, which sets Prior alpha, Prior beta, Observed successes, and Observed failures.
explorations.observe: The Posterior alpha readout rises to 9, Posterior beta to 3, and the Posterior mean becomes 0.75, moving from the Prior mean of 0.5 toward the sample proportion 0.8.
explorations.why: The update adds successes to alpha and failures to beta, so the data counts are as influential as the prior pseudo-counts; the posterior mean is a weighted average that here lands at 9/(9+3).

explorations.title: A strong prior resists little data
explorations.instruction: Predict: using alpha=10 and beta=10 (prior mean 0.5), how far will 2 successes and 0 failures move the posterior mean? Then apply the preset, which sets Prior alpha, Prior beta, Observed successes, and Observed failures.
explorations.observe: Posterior alpha becomes 12, Posterior beta becomes 10, and the Posterior mean is only about 0.545, barely above the Prior mean of 0.5.
explorations.why: The prior pseudo-counts (20 total) outweigh the 2 observations, so the posterior mean is pulled toward 0.5 more than toward the sample proportion 1.
